evaluation_reserve.nq_source: All original reserved_evaluation IDs, including quarantined records; never reassign them to training or tuning
evaluation_reserve.fever_source: All valid binary-gold candidates in the final hash partition after excluding known exposed IDs
evaluation_reserve.rule: 500 is the predeclared evaluated subset, not the full protected pool; remaining reserved IDs stay sealed

sampling: Seeded SHA256 order; retain original NQ roles; FEVER canonical-query hash buckets 70/15/15; no correctness/failure-label filtering
duplicate_control: Quarantine all 35 previously flagged NQ variant rows; also NFKC + casefold + punctuation removal + whitespace collapse cross-role groups; direct content-token Jaccard >=0.60 excluded against prior exposed and previously selected queries
historical_c1_decision: Use the original NQ Train cached C1 as a historical postprocessing baseline; upstream Qwen revision/environment were not exported and remain unknown
fever_c1_decision: Generate fresh C1 on selected new claims using the T1 Qwen revision and matching FEVER index; do not reuse the old exposed 500 as new test data

team_exposure_attestation.question: 团队是否在仓库已有实验记录之外，使用过 NQ Train 或 FEVER dev 做 Diagnosis 训练、调参或错误分析？
team_exposure_attestation.scope: User-reported team usage in addition to repository audit; not a model pretraining or semantic/page isolation guarantee

label_policy: New preliminary AI/heuristic diagnosis labels are not human gold, training evidence, or sampling scores; main QA gold comes from original delivery references

resource_discovery.meaning: Remote resource discovery was unavailable; missing local assets are not proof that the team has no copy

final_candidate_meaning: Reserved for final evaluation, conditioned on completion of C1/resource/execution seals; never used for debugging, prompt design, or candidate selection
